raw_text: .NET 10 ASP.NET Core/React MVP; prefer simple, readable, composable code and clear names over generic names like Repository, Service, Manager, etc. Avoid using comments to overexplain everything. No code comments - use descriptive method/class names instead. Uses Microsoft Testing Platform (not VSTest). Test naming follows snake_case convention: `Should_do_when_something`. Mocking with NSubstitute preferred. When one of the applications is started for testing, make sure it's stopped once finished.
